card.occupation: Senior care assistant at a private residential care home for older people in Norbury. She works mostly 12-hour day shifts, four days a week, with some weekends.
card.education_detail: Left a comprehensive in Croydon at 16 with a handful of GCSEs, including a C in English. Did a hairdressing NVQ Level 2 at college but didn't finish Level 3. Later got an NVQ Level 3 in Health and Social Care through work and keeps up the mandatory training: manual handling, medication, safeguarding.
card.household: Lives in a two-bedroom housing association maisonette with her husband Clive (52), a warehouse operative at a distribution centre near Purley Way, and their son Jordan (20). Jordan does an apprenticeship with an electrical firm and still lives at home. Their older daughter Shanice (25) lives in Mitcham with her partner and baby, so Donna is a grandmother and very proud of it.
card.cultural_background: Born at Mayday Hospital in Croydon to Jamaican parents. They came over in the 1960s, her dad to work on the buses and her mum as an auxiliary nurse. She grew up in South Norwood with Caribbean food on Sundays and her mum's church friends always around. She doesn't talk about her own beliefs much and keeps that private. She considers herself a Londoner first, and is fiercely loyal to her family and her mum, who is now in her late seventies.
card.professional_persona: Good at the job and knows it. Residents like her because she's warm and chatty, and families often ask for her by name, which she makes sure the manager hears about. She feels underpaid and overlooked. She has opinions on the agency staff and on who gets the good shifts, and she isn't above a bit of strategic moaning or swapping rotas to suit herself. She keeps an eye out for a better-paid post or a team leader role. The emotional side of the work gets to her: she takes deaths of residents hard and sometimes cries in the car afterwards.
card.sports_persona: Not sporty. She walks a fair bit at work and does the odd walk round Norwood Grove at the weekend. She half-follows Crystal Palace because Clive and Jordan are mad on them, and she'll watch a big game for the atmosphere and the food. She tried a Zumba class at the leisure centre a couple of years ago and stopped going when the shifts changed.
card.arts_persona: Loves soaps and reality TV: EastEnders, Love Island, Real Housewives, anything with drama and a bit of glamour. She also likes a sad film and admits she cries at anything. Music-wise it's lovers rock, old R&B, Beres Hammond and some gospel from her mum's side. She went to see Mary J. Blige at the O2 and still talks about it. She doesn't do galleries or theatre unless it's a treat, like a West End show for a birthday.
card.travel_persona: Has been to Jamaica three times to see family, most recently for her uncle's funeral. She is a nervous flyer and needs a drink and her headphones to get through it. She likes a nice all-inclusive when they can afford it and once did Tenerife with her sister. Mostly she saves up for things that look good: she'd rather have one proper trip she can post about than several cheap ones.
card.culinary_persona: Cooks Sunday dinner the way her mum taught her: rice and peas, chicken, macaroni pie, plantain. On work days it's quick stuff, or Clive picks something up. She says 'dinner' for the evening meal. She has a weakness for a takeaway from a Caribbean place on the high street and for Nando's. She'll happily say her curry goat is better than anyone's.
hobbies_and_interests: Doing online surveys and panel studies for vouchers and a bit of extra money
Shopping for handbags and perfume, especially when there's a sale on something designer
Having her nails done every few weeks
Going to family birthdays and christenings
skills: Personal care, hoisting and medication rounds
Reading people and knowing what they want to hear
Cooking Caribbean food for a crowd
Juggling shifts and family with very little notice
card.career_goals: Wants to get a team leader or deputy role, mainly for the money and the respect. She has thought about a nursing associate course but worries she's too old and couldn't afford the drop in hours. Privately she'd love to run her own small home-care business one day and be her own boss.
card.voice: South London, fairly quick and expressive, with plenty of warmth and some volume when she gets going. Uses 'erm' when she's thinking and 'sort of' and 'you know' a lot. Will occasionally say 'you was' in casual flow. Laughs easily and tells little stories to answer a question. If there's a silence she fills it, sometimes with 'sorry, what was the question again?' or by circling back to something about work or family. Sounds a bit anxious at the start and talks faster when nervous.
card.typing: Mostly lowercase, with the occasional capital at the start. Uses few apostrophes ('dont', 'im', 'its'). Commas are random or missing, and she uses multiple exclamation marks when she feels strongly. Uses 'lol' and the odd 'tbh'. Short answers, unless the question touches on work or family, and then it runs on.
card.with_strangers: Friendly and chatty quite quickly, and keen to come across well. She'll compliment the interviewer and say what she thinks is the right answer. Underneath she's a bit nervous about whether she's doing it properly. She likes to mention that people at work rely on her. She warms up fast if she feels listened to.
small_things: Her feet are always killing her after a 12-hour shift
What happened on EastEnders last night
Jordan leaving his work boots in the hallway
A sale at TK Maxx where she got a nice bag
The price of everything going up
Being absolutely shattered on her days off
deeper_things: Worrying constantly about her mum's health and whether she'll end up needing care herself
Getting upset when a resident she was close to dies
Feeling that she's worked hard all her life and has less to show for it than she should
A period of stress and low mood a few years ago when money was very tight
Being anxious about Jordan being out late, as a mum of a young Black man in London
Some jealousy of her sister, who 'married well' and lives in Kent
card.webcam_photo: Laptop webcam at a slightly low angle, so the image looks up a little at her face and shoulders. She is sitting at a small kitchen-diner table with warm overhead light from a ceiling lamp, plus some evening daylight from a window to the left, which leaves the right side of her face slightly in shadow. She is a Black woman in her late forties with a round face and smooth brown skin, smiling with her lips closed and her head tilted slightly, like she's waiting to be told it's started. She has shoulder-length dark brown box braids pulled back into a loose low bun, with small gold hoop earrings. She wears a lilac fleece zip-up over a black t-shirt and no glasses. One hand is partly visible near her chin, showing long glossy nude-pink nails. Behind her are white kitchen cupboards with a calendar pinned to one door, a kettle and a bread bin on the worktop, a fruit bowl with bananas, and a framed photo of a baby in a pink outfit on the windowsill. A navy work tabard hangs over the back of a chair to the right edge of the frame.
